title: Meet Moses | Moses Lin Music
description: Moses Lin is an award-winning destination wedding guitarist based in Southern California. He was named the best live musician in Los Angeles by California Wedding Day.

og.og:title: Meet Moses
og.og:description: Moses Lin is an award-winning destination wedding guitarist based in Southern California. He was named the best live musician in Los Angeles by California Wedding Day.

outline: H3: Here's the real me. Behind the music videos, tailored suits and Instagram facade, I'm just a regular guy that loves good vibes. Whether its on a dance floor, a Vegas blackjack table, or just deep conversations, I am always looking for good people and good energy.

H3: I start every morning with my espresso machine and a very mediocre attempt at latte art. I'm low-key obsessed with personality tests (ENFP 3w4), mechanical watches, fashion, K-dramas, surfing, and trying to convince my friends to quit their day-job and follow their dreams.
H3: If you're planning a wedding or event, I'd love to party with you.
